title: EquiDermAI: An Inclusive Deep-Generative Framework to Overcome Racial & Regional Barriers in Skin Disease Diagnosis
summary: EquiDermAI uses generated skin-lesion images and compact on-device models to narrow skin-tone gaps in diagnosis, and its makers report that full validation is ongoing.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: In an account published by the International Telecommunication Union in 2025, the Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) describes skin-tone data augmentation and on-device dermatology models. The contacts are Akshat Santhana Gopalan and Narayanan Madaboosi Srinivasan of IIT Madras. The account lists the country as the United States and names no partners. Mobile prototyping and validation are ongoing. The makers name fairer diagnostic performance, lower energy use and access in resource-constrained settings as intended benefits. No reduction in existing health disparities has been demonstrated. A GitHub repository by Akshat Santhana Gopalan, created on 22 September 2024, holds an offline iOS app for Mpox and melanoma. Its README says that the CycleGAN augmentation and tinyML pipeline are not in the repository. No paper or independent evaluation of EquiDermAI had been published by October 2026.
purpose: Improve dermatology-model performance across skin tones and low-resource devices.

ratings.reason: The makers are still validating a mobile prototype of EquiDermAI, and no source shows that a patient benefited.
Fairer performance across skin tones and lower mortality are intended effects. No source measures a change in existing health disparities.

evidence.quote: While full validation is ongoing, the quantized model has been designed with considerations for low latency and a compact memory footprint suitable for on-device inference.

evidence.citation: Akshat Santhana Gopalan (AkshatSG), EquiDermAI repository README, GitHub, created 22 September 2024. The developer wrote this README; it shows that an on-device iOS app for Mpox and melanoma existed by late 2024 and that the augmentation and tinyML parts are not in the repository.

evidence.quote: This is the iOS implementation for EquiDermAI, an AI tool to help individuals diagnose Mpox and Melanoma in resource constrained areas simply with a smartphone.
